examples.name: start
examples.requirements: Run each marked stage in a separate resident workbench cell, in order. The Project.BackgroundCommandExample source must be on the selected source path. Query evidence after completion, then finish the watcher.

examples.name: readSnapshot
examples.requirements: Requires FsRead, FsWrite and Console. Uses and replaces the named scratch note. Read contents and version together, commit to that captured destination, and observe stale-write refusal. Only filesystem-effect writers participate in the shared advisory lock; external writers are outside the guarantee.

examples.name: lookupIndex
examples.requirements: Import Project.RetainedLookupExample and call capture with Lookup available. Display lookupIndex of the returned batch, then sections or firstSignatureLine. Navigation is pure over that exact batch; missing examples/source are explicit, and no discovered runtime authority or upstream completeness is implied.
